subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should OpenClaw support Browserbase Sessions API lifecycle as a first-party browser profile driver, route it through a generic browser-backend/plugin seam, or document Browserbase static-CDP setup as unsupported now?
rationale: The durable fix changes commercial-service integration scope, public browser profile config, credential policy, signed URL handling, and remote browser-control lifecycle, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary.

options.title: Revise First-Party Driver
options.body: Accept a Browserbase driver only after the open PR resolves route coverage, signed URL redaction, credential contract, cleanup semantics, upgrade behavior, and live OpenClaw browser proof.

options.title: Design Generic Backend Seam
options.body: Keep Browserbase behind the broader browser backend/plugin API so service-specific drivers can live outside core once registration is available.

options.title: Document Unsupported
options.body: Stop recommending the static Browserbase setup and document the manual Sessions API workaround until maintainers are ready to own Browserbase lifecycle support.

recommendation.title: Revise First-Party Driver
recommendation.body: Accept a Browserbase driver only after the open PR resolves route coverage, signed URL redaction, credential contract, cleanup semantics, upgrade behavior, and live OpenClaw browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across browser runtime seams, plugin-boundary decisions, and recent remote CDP policy work.
